notes: The following notes are provided regarding the GSA NIST 800-53A, Revision 5 Test Cases.

1 The test cases were developed using Google Sheets, if you are using an Excel version formatting is likely to be affected. The only known useability issue is that row height in the test cases is reduced. To correct, select the affected rows and use Autoformat-Row-Height from the Home-Cells menu.

2 The test cases use formulas to calculate system and summary information about controls based on assessment objectives using a Logic tab. Do not delete any tabs, rows, columns, or cells, this will affect the calculations and invalidate the test case workbook.
3 For performing assessments the following definitions of Examine, Interview, and Test are from NIST SP 800-53A, Revision 5.

Examine - The examine method is the process of reviewing, inspecting, observing, studying, or analyzing one or more assessment objects (i.e., specifications, mechanisms, or activities). The purpose of the examine method is to facilitate assessor understanding, achieve clarification, or obtain evidence.

Interview - The interview method is the process of holding discussions with individuals or groups of individuals within an organization to facilitate assessor understanding, achieve clarification, or obtain evidence.

Test - The test method is the process of exercising one or more assessment objects (i.e., activities or mechanisms) under specified conditions to compare an actual and desired state or expected behavior.
